reviews.title: Solid 140mm fans. Very satisfied.
reviews.comment: Easy to install. Color is nice. RGB works great. Fan RPM looks like it caps out around 1300 RPM (I usually cap at 90%). Noise is actually not that bad. Is it noticeable at say 50% speed compared to 100% speed? Yes, however, surprisingly, it makes less noise than my 120mm fans at the same RPM. Airflow is good. My 7900XT has hotspots in the upper 70s on max settings and my 5600X temps are around low 60s under load. Great price to performance ratio. I'll probably come back to this company if I need fans in the future. Also, in case people care about tower aesthetics, the screws that come with the white fans are silver, so it'll stand out a bit depending on your tower..
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.title: Best budget-quality fans.
reviews.comment: The 3 of them works as intended. The reach 1500 rpm with barely any noise. In case like me that use Control Fan y like to have their fans turned off when temp allows it, this one isn't possible, it lowers to 300 ish rpm but do not turn off but this is just a detail. It have great air volume as advertised and allowed me to lower up to 5° more the hotspot temp of my gpu when in heavy load compared to my previous solution (a Noctua NF-P14s redux-1500 + a cheap 140 mm. 800 rpm 4-pin IDE molex fan) while increasing the Power limit to the max. (15 is the max and I had it on 10 before). Aesthetically they are very good looking. It combines very well with a white build.
reviews.author: Ezequiel

reviews.title: A great balance of value and quality
reviews.comment: These things are a legendarily heat value. Noise is medium-low, in line with their rating. At this size you don’t get any high pitched whine. Airflow seems fine, but these are connected to a header that is mostly off during normal use. Cable length was too long in one case and too short in another. Honestly, just plan with this like any build. Route first, tie down later. Quality is great. No concerns about snapping blades.
reviews.author: S. M. Pitman

reviews.title: Value, quality
reviews.comment: I love these fans, they move good air, are a good price if you need more than one.  They look good, the LEDs are pretty nice and they seem like quality fans.  A little noisier at max level, but they still run well when not maxed out and are quiet at like half speed.
reviews.author: Joking85

reviews.title: Buy a fan controller too!!!!!!
reviews.comment: I am happy with my purchase. The fan blades are translucent grey, not white; I do not notice when they are spinning and the lights are on. They are kind of  a pain to wire. I recommend getting a fan controller (I did not have one when installing them) They are super easy to screw in. They include short screws but not long screws. At full speed they are not very loud, but not quiet.
